launch_conditions: sole heavy job; MemAvailable >= 22,000,000,000 bytes (cap + 4 GB) at launch; new --out-dir and new --manifest (the hardened builder refuses to overwrite either); peak recorded, run stopped above 95% of the cap

method.added_by_hardening: hashing 28.82 GB of stored holder bytes (270 rows) and 1,259 edit.json files, plus a per-row checkpoint; estimated well under 0.25 h, not separately measured
method.peak: set by setup (11,327,195,583-byte field held whole, factors, base), not by row count: ~17.18 GB for any row subset; the F12-R guards add only hashing and small records
method.rule: wall = setup + per_tensor_seconds x stored tensors of the rows run; setup is fixed (whole field, all 186 K frames, spectral factors) whatever the row count
method.threads: 6, as the frozen run: fp32 results depend on the intra-op thread count (tests/conftest.py), so a bitwise comparison needs the frozen run's threads and library versions

A_full_rerun.does_not_establish: the dead implementer session's history (no rerun can)
A_full_rerun.establishes: bitwise reproduction by the hardened builder of every frozen output (tokens.safetensors X/presence/row_eligible, detail.jsonl, aq.json, kframes, rows.jsonl except 'seconds') for all 270 rows, on inputs authenticated row by row

B_stratified_sample_plus_all_row_authent.does_not_establish: observed bitwise reproduction of the 246 unsampled rows' token values: that is inferred from AST-identical numerical functions, identical authenticated inputs and deterministic CPU kernels at fixed threads and library versions
B_stratified_sample_plus_all_row_authent.establishes: bitwise reproduction on every family/inner-family/rank code path (24 rows) and of all 186 K frames (computed in setup); every row's input increment equals the frozen run's; every input authenticated
B_stratified_sample_plus_all_row_authent.plus_within_4GB: for all 270 rows: inputs authenticated (stored bytes = resolved_delta_hash, edit.json via the snapshot index) and the realised increment's sha256 recomputed tensor by tensor at the bf16 base and compared with the frozen rows.jsonl increment_sha256 (f12e_token_facts realised_increment_sha256_by_row); priced like the streaming plan (16 roots in 78 s, peak 2.64 GB): about 0.5 h wall, <= 1 CPU-h, < 3 GB; no chair ruling needed
prerequisites_not_implemented: a comparison script against the frozen outputs (reads the real token arrays; to be run by the authorised session)
B_stratified_sample_plus_all_row_authent.sample_rule: strata = family x chain inner family x recorded rank (12 strata); within each, the 2 rows with the smallest sha256(UTF-8 '20261112:f12-r:sample:' + id) (all rows if fewer); content-independent, chosen before any rerun

recommended: B (cheapest valid evidence); A if Board A requires observed bitwise reproduction of every row (same memory ruling, about 5 h more wall)
